q: At least 5 years of hands-on experience with D365 F&O across Finance, Project Management & Accounting and Supply Chain Management modules

r: We are looking for a FinOps Expert / Solution Architect to own our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (Finance, Projects and SCM) and D365 Sales platforms. You will be the go-to expert who keeps the system stable, helps our people use it well, and drives continuous improvement across the business. This is a fully remote role, working closely with our Finance, Procurement, Projects & Operations and Commercial teams in Abu Dhabi.
Own day-to-day L1/L2 support for D365 F&O (Finance, SCM, Projects) and D365 Sales, making sure users get quick resolutions and clear guidance
Manage the full ticket lifecycle, from intake and prioritisation to troubleshooting, resolution and closure

Lead incident and problem management to identify recurring issues and put permanent fixes in place
Coordinate controlled changes and releases, including impact assessment, testing, release readiness and post-release validation
Work with business teams to translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria
Build internal D365 capability through training, documentation and a network of D365 Champions and super-users
Support access and licence governance, aligning permissions to real job needs and helping deliver licence cost optimisation
